reason: In store.js.es6:64-72, `find` returns a result set only when `typeof findArgs === "object"`. When `store.find('embedding')` is called with no id, `findArgs` is undefined, so the code takes the `_hydrate(type, result['embedding'], result)` branch and builds one record. The custom adapter (admin/adapters/embedding.js.es6:4-6) points at the singleton endpoint `/admin/customize/embedding`, so this is not a collection.
